messages.subject: Crash for "weibullsurv" model
parts:
Dear All, 

I have implemented an exponential survival model with R-INLA for my dataset and it worked. But when I have tested with a Weibull survival model (
family="weibullsurv" I got this error message:


Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
In addition: Warning message:
running command '"C:\Users\denis-m\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpglO5rx\fileb384db934cd.BAT"' had status 3 

May it due to the default priors? or something else?


Thanks for your help.
Marie.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Crash for "weibullsurv" model
parts:
have you tried to scale the data, like

time = time / max(time)

?? since 'time' enter the exponent it can be sensitive to 'bad
scaling' of the response

H
